title: TEF-RAG v5.1 Failure Attribution
warning: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — NOT AVAILABLE AT RETRIEVAL TIME. This is a seen diagnostic set. The analysis is for failure attribution and model development only. It must not be reported as a new unbiased holdout result.
main_finding: Exact and Beam select the same objective-optimal sets on every set-mode query. The observed Complete@5 failures therefore cannot be attributed to beam approximation on this diagnostic set.
recommended_next_step: Search is not the primary issue on these 8/12-candidate pools. The next stage should investigate a preregistered closure-/flow-completion-aware v6 objective and independently validate it, without tuning on this seen set.
